name: Upselia – AI Sales Assistant
author: Jesús Lopez

sections.description:
Upselia adds Valeria to your WooCommerce store: a sales assistant that talks to your customers, understands what they are looking for, asks the right questions (budget, size, colour…) and recommends products from your own catalogue.

Everything is managed from your WordPress admin:

  • One-click connection — press “Connect with Upselia”, log in (or create your account) and you are back, connected. No codes to copy.
  • Your catalogue, always up to date — products, variations (size, colour…), brands, sale prices and stock are copied automatically in the background and updated when they change.
  • Sales from the chat and from emails — Upselia knows which paid orders came from a chat conversation or from an email, without receiving your customers’ personal data.
  • Abandoned carts — the recovery email link rebuilds the cart, even on another device.
  • Discounts with your own coupons — choose one of the coupons you created in WooCommerce and Valeria offers it with the same conditions. Upselia never creates discounts for you.
  • The Upselia panel inside WordPress — set up Valeria, automatic emails and campaigns, see contacts and conversations, your plan and invoices without leaving your admin.

The plugin does not slow down your store: all communication with Upselia happens in the background (Action Scheduler) and, if Upselia is unavailable, your store works as usual (the chat just does not show).

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or later.
  • An Upselia account (you can create it while connecting). Upselia is a paid service; see the plans at upselia.es.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Upselia (https://upselia.es), the service that runs the Valeria assistant. It is required for the plugin to work.

Nothing is sent to Upselia until you press “Connect with Upselia”.

  • Chat widget — the script https://chat.upselia.es/widget.js is loaded on your store’s pages (only while connected and where you choose to show the chat). The visitor’s messages to Valeria are sent to Upselia so it can answer. The widget stores a chat session identifier in the visitor’s browser (localStorage and the ups_sid cookie, 30 days) to keep the conversation and to know if an order came from the chat.
  • AI provider — to write Valeria’s answers, Upselia sends the chat messages to OpenAI (https://openai.com), which acts as Upselia’s data processor and does not use them to train its models. The plugin itself never contacts OpenAI. OpenAI terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use — privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Connection — when you press “Connect with Upselia”, your browser goes to https://panel.upselia.es/conectar with your store address. Your store then exchanges a one-time code for its own key (https://panel.upselia.es/api/conectar/canjear).
  • Catalogue — product data (name, description, price, sale price, categories, tags, brand, attributes, SKU, stock, availability, URL and image) is sent to https://panel.upselia.es/api/tienda/catalogo when you connect, once a day and whenever a product changes.
  • Orders — for orders placed after connecting: order number, status, total, currency, purchased product IDs and the chat session identifier are sent to https://panel.upselia.es/api/tienda/pedido. No customer personal data (name, email, address, phone) is ever sent.
  • Discount — if you choose one of your coupons for Valeria to offer, its code and conditions (percentage, minimum amount, excluded categories and products) are sent to https://panel.upselia.es/api/config, and again when you change that coupon.
  • Store status and domain check — the plugin asks https://panel.upselia.es/api/tienda/estado for your chat settings every few hours and, to prove the store is yours, asks https://panel.upselia.es/api/tienda/verificar-dominio to call your site, which answers with a signature (never the key).
  • Technical versions — every request your store makes to https://panel.upselia.es includes the versions of WooCommerce, WordPress, PHP and this plugin, so Upselia knows which versions it has to support. No personal data is included.
  • Privacy text — the paragraph about the chat for your privacy policy is downloaded from https://panel.upselia.es/api/privacidad-tienda once a week.
  • Panel — the Upselia panel shown in your admin requests your Upselia data (settings, contacts, conversations, plan, invoices) from https://panel.upselia.es/api/… through your own site. The panel’s code, fonts and logo are included in the plugin; nothing is loaded from other sites.
  • Disconnecting — when you disconnect or delete the plugin, https://panel.upselia.es/api/tienda/desconectar is called so the store’s key stops working.

Upselia terms of service: https://upselia.es/terminos
Upselia privacy policy: https://upselia.es/privacidad

Credits

The panel includes the fonts Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans, both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. Go to Upselia in your WordPress menu.
  3. Press Connect with Upselia, log in or create your account, and confirm.
  4. Done: Valeria appears in your store and your products are copied in a couple of minutes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Upselia account?

Yes. If you do not have one, you can create it during the connection.

Is my customers’ personal data sent to Upselia?

The plugin never sends your customers’ name, email, address or phone. Upselia only receives what visitors write to Valeria in the chat (for example, an email they choose to leave) and, for orders, the order number, status, amount and products.

What happens if Upselia is down?

Your store keeps working normally. The chat does not show and changes are sent when Upselia is back.

How do I disconnect my store?

In Upselia, press “Disconnect” at the top. You can also disconnect it from your Upselia account. If you delete the plugin, the store is disconnected too.
sections.changelog:
2.3.5

  • The “store disconnected” notice only appears on the Dashboard and the Plugins screen, and can be dismissed.

2.3.4

  • Large catalogs copy several times faster, and your Upselia dashboard shows the progress (“350 of 1,200 products”).
  • If Upselia cannot accept your catalog, the plugin now tells you why instead of failing silently.

2.3.3

  • The chat script is now loaded deferred, so it never delays your store pages.
  • Prices in the chat are shown in your store currency.

2.3.2

  • The Upselia dashboard inside WordPress is now fully translated into English, and coupon details are shown in your admin language.

2.3.1

  • Products are now sent with their parent categories too (for example “Backpacks” as well as “Day hiking”), so Valeria finds them by any of them.

2.3.0

  • The plugin tells Upselia which versions of WooCommerce, WordPress and PHP the store runs (technical data only), so new versions are supported sooner.

2.2.2

  • New look for the chat: default colour, and the bubble’s pulse and the red “1” can be turned off from “Chat on the store”.
  • Fix: the panel’s fonts and logo are now included in the plugin (they were requested from the store and not found).
  • Fix: the coupon summary shows the store’s currency.
  • The WordPress admin never waits for Upselia when loading the privacy text or when a coupon changes.

2.2.1

  • Connect your email tool (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Brevo, ActiveCampaign or a webhook) from the Upselia dashboard inside WordPress.

2.2.0

  • Privacy: option to add the Upselia paragraph to your privacy policy automatically (or copy it from your Upselia dashboard).

2.1.0

  • Security: Upselia now checks that the connected store really is yours before showing the chat on it (automatic, nothing to do).

2.0.0

  • One-click connection with a per-store key that can be revoked (no more copying the store code).
  • The whole Upselia panel inside WordPress.
  • Catalogue copy in the background: variations, brands, attributes, sale prices and stock, updated when they change.
  • Orders reported from the server with their status (paid, cancelled, refunded) to know the sales from the chat and from emails.
  • Abandoned cart links that rebuild the cart.
  • Discount based on your own WooCommerce coupons (Upselia never creates coupons).
  • WooCommerce only (Easy Digital Downloads, Ecwid and WP eCommerce removed).
  • Security: saving a product no longer replaces the whole catalogue and no longer waits for Upselia.

1.0.0

  • First version.
